autopurgeDescription: Purge channels of their messages every so often.
autopurgeEnableDescription: Purge a channel every interval, of every message or of the ones a filter looks for.
autopurgeListDescription: List the channels that are purged.
autodeleteDescription: Delete the messages of channels as they are sent, or a delay after.
autodeleteEnableDescription: Delete the messages sent in a channel, at once or a delay after.
autodeleteDisableDescription: Stop deleting the messages of a channel.
autodeleteListDescription: List the channels whose messages are deleted.
optionsIntervalDescription: How often the channel is purged, for example 30m, 6h or 1d. From 5 minutes to 14 days.
optionsFilterDescription: Which messages are deleted, every message when omitted.
optionsValueDescription: The user, or the text, of the filters that need one.
optionsDelayDescription: How long a message stays, for example 30s or 10m. At once when omitted, 24 hours at most.
optionsAllowLinksDescription: Keep the messages that have a link.
optionsAllowInvitesDescription: Keep the messages that have an invite.
optionsAllowImagesDescription: Keep the messages that have an image.
optionsAllowMentionsDescription: Keep the messages that mention somebody.
optionsAllowEmbedsDescription: Keep the messages that have an embed.
optionsAllowTextDescription: Keep the messages that are only text, without attachments.
optionsBotsDescription: Delete the messages of bots and webhooks too, they are kept otherwise.
filterNotContains: Messages that do not contain a text
filterStartsWith: Messages that start with a text
filterEndsWith: Messages that end with a text
valueInvalidUser: The `value` of that filter is a user: mention them, or write their ID.
channelUnknown: I could not find that channel in this server.
missingPermissions: I cannot delete messages in {{channel}}, I am missing: {{missing, list(conjunction)}}.
autopurgeLimit: This server already has {{maximum, number}} purged channels, which is the most it can have. Disable one first.
autopurgeListEmpty: No channel is purged. Purge one with {{command}}.
autodeleteLimit: This server already deletes the messages of {{maximum, number}} channels, which is the most it can. Disable one first.
autodeleteEnabledNow: The messages sent in {{channel}} are deleted at once.
autodeleteEnabledAfter: The messages sent in {{channel}} are deleted after {{delay}}, but the ones that are pinned meanwhile.
autodeleteBotsKept: The messages of bots and webhooks are kept.
autodeleteBotsDeleted: The messages of bots and webhooks are deleted too, but mine.
autodeleteDisabled: The messages of {{channel}} are no longer deleted.
autodeleteNotEnabled: The messages of {{channel}} were not deleted.
autodeleteListEmpty: No channel has its messages deleted. Set one up with {{command}}.
